howto.name: Upload an AVI
howto.text: Drop an .avi video — typical for older Windows captures.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The result is an MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio, ready for streaming on phones, browsers, and modern TVs.

faq.a: AVI is an old Microsoft container with poor support for modern codecs and metadata. MP4 is the universal standard — every modern device, browser, and editor plays it.

faq.q: What if my AVI uses DivX or Xvid?
faq.a: FFmpeg re-encodes the video to H.264 inside the MP4 container, so any source codec is handled.

faq.q: Will the file get bigger or smaller?
faq.a: Usually similar or smaller. Old AVIs often used inefficient codecs; modern H.264 typically achieves the same quality at a smaller size.
